US Prosecutors Investigate Epstein Estate Executors

Federal prosecutors in New York have opened an investigation into the executors managing Jeffrey Epstein's estate, identified as his longtime lawyer and accountant. The probe is reportedly focused on their handling of the estate and payments to victims.
